set.body: Outcome: bounded local stimulus-ASR comparison after owner requested triangulation. Preserve production transcripts. Scope: fixed excerpts totaling about14min spanning ordinary dialogue, known suspicious boundaries, song, 5zeroVADclips and synthetic silence. Compare existing baseline/excerpt-Metalgreedy, no-concatenation bounded-speech decoding, temperature fallback, independent Parakeet on unfiltered audio, and CPUbeam5 on a small fixed subset. Pin inputs/settings/models/runtime and retain raw outputs/failures. No participant recall/gold reads; existing stimulus subtitle may support a separately labelled comparison only. No automatic consensus/LLMrewrite; disagreement is not accuracy. No new Scala types/deps/API. Success: actual completed/failed outcome per selected variant, checked source-clock word times, inspectable disagreements, adverse evidence and clear next decision. Human-reference accuracy remains unestablished. Local native GPU authorized by owner's short comparison request; no external inference/offload/publication.
set.title: [media] Compare bounded ASR settings and independent recognizer
